dedupe_keys.name: updated south african cropland extent 2013 2015 landsat

description: This dataset is an updated cropland extent map of South Africa for 2013 to 2015, derived from multi-sensor Landsat data and historical land cover (National Land Cover 2000), according to the figshare record. It was published on 14 September 2016 by François Waldner, with files of about 64 MB, downloadable and free under CC BY 4.0, with national coverage of South Africa. Caveats: the page gives a one-sentence description, so the pixel size, the file format, the accuracy and the class scheme are not stated on the page read, and the map is not updated after 2015. For simulation it gives cropland extent to expose South African farmland to drought, floods and fire, and to estimate farm service areas for irrigation, grain storage and rural road models. Related catalogue records include the Unified Cropland Layer and the percent cropland coverage map for sub-Saharan Africa.
name: Updated South African cropland extent 2013-2015 (Landsat)
